result.title: Faithful Explanations under Missing Modalities in Multimodal Dementia Prognosis
result.summary: Large language models are increasingly used to turn the feature attributions of multimodal prognostic models into narratives for clinicians, yet costly modalities such as amyloid PET and cerebrospinal fluid biomarkers are often missing, and whether these explanations stay faithful under missing evidence has not been tested. We separate two failure points: phantom attribution, in which the model credits modalities that were never observed, and unfaithful narration, in which the report omits, cites or misjudges missing modalities. Using 307 participants of the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative with complete data, we masked every subset of four costly modalities, predicted 36-month conversion from mild cognitive impairment to Alzheimer's disease, and restored the masked data to obtain interventional ground truth. All five missing-data strategies assigned 12% to 23% of attribution to unobserved modalities, and up to 45% with four absent; missingness-aware strategies minimised it at no cost in accuracy. Across 51,200 reports from four language models and four prompting regimes, naming absent modalities in the prompt raised acknowledgement from 48% to 88% and cut phantom evidence twenty-fold, but advice on whether acquiring a missing test would change the prediction was correct in only 27% to 41% of cases until checked against executed restorations, which raised accuracy to 69% for open-weight narrators and 99.9% for a proprietary model. Higher phantom attribution was associated with more phantom evidence and fewer faithful direction claims, and direction fidelity, measured by a calibrated language-model judge, depended on narrator scale rather than prompting. Narrators told to name absent modalities sometimes declared observed ones absent, an error that a structured template eliminated. We release the masking protocol and evaluation code.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 307 名 ADNI 参与者的多模态痴呆预后任务中遮蔽四种高成本模态，再用恢复被遮蔽数据得到的干预式真值，检验归因是否被分配给从未观测的模态（phantom attribution）、以及 LLM 生成的解释叙述是否忠实，并比较缺失感知策略、提示方式与结构化模板的作用。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「遮蔽—恢复」干预协议与「引用未观测证据」的度量，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据缺失或未被使用时解释是否虚构证据，而「补测是否会改变预测」的评估线索可能对应证据获取价值与获取/停止决策。
